items.difficulty_reason: 43 行、两向：①(2) 由 (1) 直接得出 + 仿射范畴等价词典（lemma-affine-compare-bounded）；②正向：tor amplitude ⇒ 平坦代表元集中于 [a,b]，取 tilde 后每项平坦，由 cohomology-lemma-tor-amplitude 给 E 的 amplitude；③反向：E 有 amplitude ⇒ 有界 ⇒ M 在 K^-(A)，换成自由无界上代表，用 ⊗ 与 tilde 的相容性把 E ⊗^L N~ 算成 (M ⊗ N)~，层上同调消失 ⇒ M 的 amplitude。承重的两个方向都在 span 内；3 处引用（1 同章、2 跨章）作导航桩。与 S7-per-tor-dimension-rel-affine（L22089，2551-2597，相对 f^{-1}O_S 情形）是相邻的姊妹命题，命题不同、区间不相交。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-tor-dimension-affine (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2507-2518

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the passage from a flat representative of the module complex to a flat complex of sheaves with the same amplitude, and the converse computation of the derived tensor with an arbitrary module through the tilde correspondence, using the affine identification of derived categories (source lines 2520-2549)
